params.body:
Closes finding X-23 (`de-code-wil-bij-authentication-error-de`), one of the disputed rules.

`handleVhrResult` carried a branch for `AUTHENTICATION_ERROR` *behind* the gate that lets only `PROCESSED` through, so it could never run. A dealer whose Car-Pass password was wrong read "carpass niet gekoppeld!", which sends him nowhere. The message written for him, "Ongeldige combinatie afzender en/of wachtwoord", sends him straight to his settings.

The branch now sits before that gate, and the dead copy below it is gone.

**One half was deliberately not carried over.** The old branch also cleared the vehicle's `carpass_init` and `carpass_id`. That is wrong twice: the password of the *dealer* says nothing about the report of the *vehicle*, and a vehicle coming through here for its six-month renewal (R S3-2.8) would lose a valid report over one mistyped letter. Handled before anything is written, there is also nothing left to clear. If you do want that wipe, it is one line — but as a decision, not as a leftover of code that never ran.

**PHPStan had already found it.** `phpstan-baseline.neon` carried `Strict comparison using === between 'PROCESSED' and 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR' will always evaluate to false` — the finding itself, silenced. That entry is gone; the baseline goes from 925 to 924.

`AWrongCarpassPasswordSaysSoTest`: the message, the report that stays put, and the boundary that any other failed status keeps the general message. Verified to bite by putting the branch back behind the gate.

R S3-2.8 moves from `betwist` to `code`; disputed rules 36 → 35. Full suite green, PHPStan clean.
params.title: A wrong Car-Pass password says so
